name: revive-api
description: API RESTful para o aplicativo REVIVE - Plataforma de apoio à recuperação de vícios

scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -n api,painel "npm run dev" "npm run dev --prefix revive-painel"
scripts.dev:homolog: concurrently -n api,painel "npm run dev" "npm run dev:homolog --prefix revive-painel"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:api: npm run test:api:unit && npm run test:api:integration
scripts.test:web: npm run test:unit --prefix revive-painel && npm run test:integration --prefix revive-painel
scripts.validate: npm run check:docs && npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run build:web
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser:sessions && npm run test:browser:storage && npm run test:browser:sync && npm run test:browser:shell && npm run test:browser:client && npm run test:browser:offline-ui && npm run test:browser:progress

author: Equipe REVIVE
